caption:
Spain holds snap election, its fifth general vote in over a decade

Pedro Sánchez · Politics

Center-right leader Alberto Núñez Feijóo is bidding to end Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez's eight-year run in power. Socialist Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez called the snap vote, arguing that his minority government needs broader support to pass pending reforms.

Reported by Bloomberg; France 24.
